newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Friday 95,000 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Friday 95,000 - USDA.

text.p: USDA estimated interior Iowa and southern Minnesota hog receipts were:
Fridays estimate: 95,000 Wk ago: Holiday Yr ago: 84,000
Saturdays est: 15,000 Wk ago: 7,000 Yr ago: 7,000

Estimates include generally about 65 percent Carcass Base Hogs. Barrows and gilts were steady to $0.50 per cwt higher than the midsession Thursday. Trade was slow for moderate to good demand and light to moderate offerings.

Compared to last week: Barrows and Gilts $0.50 lower. Sows steady to 2.00 higher. Receipts this week 515,000, last week 419,000, last year 481,000. Barrows and Gilts average weight for week ending July 5, 1997 250.9 lbs compared to 252.1 lbs previous week 246.6 lbs last year.
